column1: # Genes whose pathogenic alleles are mostly events short-read SNV calling cannot see: copy number between paralogs, gene conversion with a pseudogene, inversions, repeat expansions (track design, A4). `genokeeper genotype --gene` names the mechanism beside the gene's counts, so "none of the N known pathogenic variants carried" is never read as reassurance.

# source: GeneReviews (Adam MP et al., eds., University of Washington, Seattle; https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK1116/), one chapter per row, named in the row with its authors, NBK and PMID, and the revision date its PubMed record gives

# checked: 2026-10-19, each chapter's title, authors, NBK accession and revision date against its PubMed record (NCBI E-utilities efetch, Europe PMC); the mechanism column summarises the chapter's molecular genetics without percentages, because the Bookshelf full text sat behind a browser check and the figures could not be re-read that day
# genes: the six the track design names (SMN1, HBA1, HBA2, CYP21A2, GBA1, F8) and two more on the ACMG carrier Tier 3 list (DMD, FMR1); symbols as ClinVar GENEINFO writes them
